name: FacilityAgreement
description: The executed facility agreement record created by SVC-005 (Commercial Banking Core) in PH-020 (JRN-007) following credit approval. Captures legally binding commercial terms: approved amount, pricing (SONIA + margin), repayment schedule, financial covenants, and conditions precedent. The definitive contract record governing the LoanAccount. signed_date populated on EVT-036 (FacilityAgreed).

fields.name: rate
fields.validation_rule: Required. Object: base_rate (sonia | fixed), margin_bps (integer), total_rate_pct (decimal, 4 dp). GOV-002-R05 requires APRC-equivalent disclosure.

fields.name: covenants
fields.validation_rule: Required for facilities > £250,000. Covenant: covenant_type, target_value, test_frequency, test_date_start.

fields.name: signed_date
fields.validation_rule: Required. ISO 8601 (YYYY-MM-DD). Date of customer execution. Immutable. Must be on or before drawdown date.

fields.name: conditions_precedent
fields.validation_rule: Optional. Each CP: cp_type, description, due_date, satisfied (boolean), satisfied_date. All must be satisfied before drawdown.

fields.name: term_months
fields.validation_rule: Required. Positive integer. Copied from LoanApplication.term_months unless modified by committee.

relationships.description: FacilityAgreement belongs to one LoanApplication via application_id FK.

design_decisions.decision: Covenants defined on FacilityAgreement — the single source of truth for agreed covenant terms.
design_decisions.rationale: Covenant terms are contractually agreed and immutable without formal amendment. CovenantMonitoring (ENT-021) references these definitions.
